title: TDMA static latch can initialize before load_key freezing stale epoch-derived slot
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c:47-64 lazily initializes function-static tdma_ctx above has_key check capturing ctx->epoch at first TX; later load_key rotates epoch but tdma_init_done latch prevents slot recomputation -> node hashed onto stale slot indefinitely. Inert today (time source FIXME), live once wired. Violates AGENTS.md init graph ordering requirement. Fix: latch after successful key load or recompute on epoch change.
close_reason: lichen_link_tx.c TDMA gate moved below has_key/ENOKEY check so lazy tdma_init can no longer freeze an epoch-derived slot from a keyless context; static latch extended with tdma_epoch_seen and re-inits whenever ctx->epoch rotates after load_key (init-done flag respected; exactly-once init per epoch). Aligns with AGENTS.md init graph load_key->tdma_init. Verified by clang -fsyntax-only; tx-path EBUSY/ENOKEY ordering audited against test suite (no assertions depend on old order; slot-0 pass-through behavior at now=0 unchanged). FIXME time source left out of scope.
